tables.name: Included Location
tables.description: The locations each district type automatically has. Set, never rolled.

results.name: Academy/University
results.description: (Non-commercial) A conservatory devoted to the pursuit of higher knowledge, sometimes of a specific area of study.

results.name: Archives/Library
results.description: (Non-commercial) A structure devoted to housing records and written information.

results.name: Artist
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses painter, sculptor or other visual art as appropriate.

results.name: Baker
results.description: (Basic) Bakes and sells fresh bread and, possibly, pastries.

results.name: Bank & Exchange
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses auctions, banking, and the specific selling of gems or exchange of currency.

results.name: Butcher
results.description: (Basic) Processes and sells fresh and/or dried meat.

results.name: Carpenter
results.description: (Basic) Builds with or carves wood, as well as carrying out repairs.

results.name: Chancery
results.description: (Non-commercial) Used as an office for official documentation and administrative tasks.

results.name: Cobbler
results.description: (Specialty) Makes and mends boots and shoes.

results.name: Courthouse
results.description: (Non-commercial) Used to hold trials or dispense justice.

results.name: Doctor/Apothecary
results.description: Provides medical care.

results.name: Forum
results.description: (Non-commercial) A place designated for the use of intellectual debate and discussion.

results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Hired Help - Hands of the Divine
results.description: Specialists trained in the use of divine magic in combat and practical mission scenarios.

results.name: Hired Help - Priestly Guidance
results.description: Sages offering counsel in all matters of religion and the divine.

results.name: Hired Help - Scribes and Clerks
results.description: Masters of history, literature, mathematics and/or business.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Inn
results.description: Provides accommodation, as well as a place to have a bath and a decent meal.

results.name: Luxury Furnishings
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells all manner of home items for fine living, including furniture, art, and other high-quality goods.

results.name: Magic Shop
results.description: (Exotic) A magic shop; its specialization is rolled.

results.name: Magic Shop - Miscellaneous & Curiosities
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells magical items with a focus on strange and rare artifacts of a wondrous or intriguing nature.

results.name: Outdoor Recreational Area
results.description: (Non-commercial) A tended space where locals might eat, take leisure time, or duel to the death...

results.name: Schoolhouse
results.description: (Non-commercial) An institution focused on educating children.

results.name: Shipwright
results.description: (Specialty) Builds and launches boats and/or ships.

results.name: Smithy
results.description: (Basic) Sells and crafts metal tools and equipment, including very basic weapons and armor.

results.name: Stable
results.description: Provides boarding accommodation for mounts, as well as selling carts, animals, and their tack.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Tavern
results.description: Provides food and drink.

results.name: Town Hall
results.description: (Non-commercial) Used for official business, audiences, and meetings.

results.name: Treasury
results.description: (Non-commercial) Used as a centralised place to manage the funds.

results.name: Weaver
results.description: (Basic) Weaves raw fabric and baskets.
